notes: AI round-trip (convert → restore to original English) records for adopted bank forms.
restore_rate = restored / trials over every (sentence × seed) trial; seeds run in parallel.
Thresholds: languages under ~100M speakers need lt100m, others ge100m; a form with trials > 0 and rate 0 is rejected for every language.
Enforcement is report-only (scripts/roundtrip.py --impact); the committed bank is not gated yet.
required: bank winners that must carry a round-trip record (nl preterite used for EN present perfect, sub-100M); regenerate with --sync-required.
Records are written by scripts/roundtrip.py --run --cmd ...; do not hand-edit counts.
